sourceBreakdowns.basis: Official Census F-33 recipient records total $1,668,554,000 of FY2024 revenue from state sources. The 25 largest systems are shown individually; remaining official system rows are transparently grouped below $1B. Recipient totals at or above $1B are split into published state-revenue components; a component still at or above $1B is labeled as the source-native disclosure ceiling. This recipient-side school-finance universe is supplemental—not additive—to state-government Census intergovernmental expenditure.
